author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read Zoom Phone's phone system operation logs and the account's call history from the Zoom Phone API. The example bridge in bridges/zoom-report-logs polls them and posts them to HTTP Ingest. Operation logs go to CloudAudit, and calls stay in Generic through the parent.
notes:
Setup:
- The example bridge in bridges/zoom-report-logs polls Zoom Phone's phone system operation logs and the account's call history from the Zoom Phone API (set ZOOM_REPORTS to phone_operationlogs,phone_call_history) and posts them to HTTP Ingest.
- Use a Server-to-Server OAuth app with only phone:read:operation_logs:admin and phone:read:list_call_logs:admin.
- Operation logs need a Pro plan or higher and a Zoom Phone plan; call history needs a Business or Enterprise account.
- The bridge puts "zoom_record" first (phone_operation or phone_call) and adds account_id.

Field mapping:
- Operation logs go to CloudAudit with the action as the event name, the category as the event type and the operator as the user; operation_detail is free text, so it goes to the additional data.
- Calls fit no schema, so they stay in Generic through the parent, with the call history ID as the event ID and the call's start as the event time.
- Direction, the international flag, numbers, countries, result and spam stay in the original data.

Sources and licenses:
- Zoom documents the operation log fields with one example (Phone Number, ADD, "Add BYOC" and a number).

Made up in the samples:
- The other categories, actions and details in the samples are made up in that shape.
- Call samples follow the call history response in Zoom's reference with made-up values.

Testing:
- The child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-22 (58 of 58 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same records there.
- The child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (46 of 46 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs), and the parent alone matched every call record.
- No built-in parser claimed these records in 3 runs.
